structured.answer: I wouldn't buy anything yet. I'd ask my son. The page's top pick is an account at פסגות with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", ending at about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. That's for its own filled-in numbers (10,000 ₪ now, 500 ₪ a month, 7% a year). At לאומי, the bank I know, it says 83,396 ₪.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the four boxes with sliders
stuck.why: I didn't know if I should change the 10,000 / 500 / 7%, so I left the page's numbers as they were
Many coloured labels with words I don't know (צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, נאמן); I couldn't tell why one fund is better
Columns of red minus amounts and lines in English (iShares, Vanguard); it made me anxious and I stopped trying to understand
Tired; the explanation at the bottom was long and small, so I stopped there

used: Title 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
Boxes סכום היום 10,000, הפקדה חודשית 500, שנים 10, תשואה בשנה 7%
Right-hand list of accounts: פסגות 86,492, לאומי 83,396, הבינלאומי 82,371, הפועלים 81,471, מזרחי טפחות 77,695
Fund name ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) at the top of the fund card
skimmed: Fund list on screens 2-4 with coloured tags
Screen 5 bottom 'למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות' and 'מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם'
skipped: 'לא בחישוב' fold-down notes under each bank
unsure_meaning: מדד (stock index, not the price index)
עוד לא נאסף / אין מחיר כאן
אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל
not_found: What happens if the fund falls, in plain words
Whether 7% a year is guaranteed or just an example
Anything about whether this is as safe as a deposit

findings.what: Page opens with English letters (S&P 500, MSCI) and the word מדד; it felt like it isn't for someone like me
Dark background with small grey text; hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: All screens, especially the date/dollar line, the colour legend and the 'לא בחישוב' notes

findings.what: Columns of red minus amounts made me back away from everything
findings.where: Screens 3-4, left column of fund list

findings.what: The amounts are set with sliders. I didn't change the page's numbers, so the 86,492 isn't about my own money
Recommended account is פסגות, a name I don't bank with; the bank I trust is lower
Bars in orange, yellow and red are too close to tell apart
Many coloured labels per fund with jargon; too busy
